title: Notices
description: Who receives the app credit and payment notifications in Bitrix24.
adminOnly: Only portal administrators choose who receives the notices.

empty.title: Notices go to the portal administrators
empty.description: Add people so they receive the notices instead of the administrators.

when.creditsOut: Credits exhausted (messages go to human agents)
when.paymentFailed: Subscription payment declined, with the deadline before agents are paused
when.periodEnd: End of the period for subscriptions contracted through CRMThink

whenNote: Each notice is sent once per cycle or per occurrence. People deactivated in the portal are ignored; if none remain, the administrators receive it.

test.sent: {count, plural, one {Test notice sent to # person. Check your Bitrix24 notifications.} other {Test notice sent to # people. Check your Bitrix24 notifications.}}
test.pending: Bitrix24 did not respond right now; the test notice will be resent shortly.
test.noRecipient: Could not send the test notice: no active recipient.
